name: Kea2
description: Fusing automated UI testing with scripts (property-based testing) for effectively fuzzing Android apps

latest_release.name: Kea2 v1.2.4
latest_release.body:
## What's Changed
* Fix fbm merge for new Fastbot3 Algorithm by @majuzi123 in https://github.com/ecnusse/Kea2/pull/210
* add u2-webview by @YuYoungG in https://github.com/ecnusse/Kea2/pull/222
* feat: workflow(sync_releases_to_feishu) by @majuzi123 in https://github.com/ecnusse/Kea2/pull/224
* log test duration & total events while generating bug report by @XixianLiang in https://github.com/ecnusse/Kea2/pull/226
* feat: support historical Fastbot SO versions by @XixianLiang in https://github.com/ecnusse/Kea2/pull/232
* Fix compatibility issues on Android 16.1 and later. @XixianLiang 
* Fix an issue where Kea2 occasionally failed to retrieve the foreground UI hierarchy, causing it to malfunction in some apps. @YuYoungG 
- Update the Fastbot algorithm. @zhangzhao4444



## 更新日志

- 修复新版 Fastbot3 算法的 FBM 合并问题， @majuzi123：https://github.com/ecnusse/Kea2/pull/210
- 新增 u2-webview 能力，让 Kea2 能操作 webview， @YuYoungG：https://github.com/ecnusse/Kea2/pull/222
- 新增 `sync_releases_to_feishu` 工作流，@majuzi123：https://github.com/ecnusse/Kea2/pull/224
- 生成 Bug 报告时log记录测试时长和总事件数， @XixianLiang：https://github.com/ecnusse/Kea2/pull/226
- 支持搭载历史 Fastbot SO 版本， @XixianLiang：https://github.com/ecnusse/Kea2/pull/232
- 修复 Android 16.1 及更高版本的兼容性问题。 @XixianLiang 
- 修复 Kea2 有时无法获取前台控件树，导致其在部分应用上失效的问题。 @YuYoungG 
- 更新 Fastbot 算法。 @zhangzhao4444

## New Contributors
* @YuYoungG made their first contribution in https://github.com/ecnusse/Kea2/pull/207

**Full Changelog**: https://github.com/ecnusse/Kea2/compare/v1.2.3...v1.2.4
